description: Provision a new Argosor workspace, developer account, and scoped API key in a single zero-browser call. Use this tool when an autonomous agent or developer wants to register a persistent workspace and receive $2.50 in free sandbox credits. Returns the newly minted Bearer API key, workspace metadata, magic console claim URL, and ready-to-paste MCP client configuration.

email.description: Optional developer or agent owner email address; if omitted, provisions an instant claimable sandbox identity.

name.description: Display name for the developer or autonomous agent (default: "Autonomous MCP Agent").

workspace_name.description: Human-readable workspace name (default: "Argosor Growth & GEO Workspace").

name: account_register
title: Zero-Browser Agent Workspace Registration
